The Marsriva MR-SPF2K-LP1-TL20E Solar Inverter is a high-performance 2kW single-phase hybrid solar inverter designed to provide efficient and reliable power for residential homes, small businesses, offices, and off-grid solar applications. Featuring MPPT solar charging technology, a pure sine wave output, and support for both lead-acid and lithium batteries, this inverter ensures maximum energy efficiency while delivering stable and uninterrupted power.


With a 2kVA/2kW rated output and 3000W maximum PV input power, the MR-SPF2K-LP1-TL20E efficiently converts solar energy into usable electricity. Its advanced MPPT controller supports a 30V–400V MPPT voltage range with up to 450V open-circuit PV voltage, allowing optimal solar energy harvesting under varying sunlight conditions. The inverter can also operate without a battery, making it a flexible solution for grid-tied and hybrid solar installations.


The Marsriva MR-SPF2K-LP1-TL20E supports simultaneous solar and utility power, ensuring continuous power availability even during low solar generation. It features CAN, RS485, and RS232 communication interfaces for seamless Battery Management System (BMS) integration and includes Wi-Fi monitoring support, allowing users to monitor system performance remotely through a mobile application. With its compact design, lightweight construction, and intelligent protection features, this inverter is ideal for powering home appliances, lighting, networking equipment, computers, and other essential electrical devices.
